newsitem.title: USA: Omega Environmental names Springel CEO.
newsitem.headline: Omega Environmental names Springel CEO.

text.p: Omega Environmental Inc named Stanford Springel as chief executive officer and also reached preliminary agreement with BNY Financial Corp for a debtor-in-possession line of credit financing.

The financing is subject to a definitive agreement and approval by the bankruptcy court. Omega, which has been operating under Chapter 11 as a Debtor-in-Possession, said Springel specializes in managing distressed companies.

Louis Tedesco resigned as chief executive, president and chairman and a director and Jeffery Weinress resigned as executive vice president and chief financial officer. Omega also named director Edward O'Sullivan as interim chairman.
